Class StructureTargetCommand

java.lang.Object
nl.pim16aap2.animatedarchitecture.core.commands.BaseCommand
nl.pim16aap2.animatedarchitecture.core.commands.StructureTargetCommand
Direct Known Subclasses:
AddOwner, Delete, Info, Lock, MovePowerBlock, RemoveOwner, SetBlocksToMove, SetOpenDirection, SetOpenStatus, SetProperty
public abstract class StructureTargetCommand extends BaseCommand
Represents a command that relates to an existing structure.

    • getRequiredProperties

      protected List<Property<?>> getRequiredProperties()
      Gets all required properties for this command.

      If targeted structure does not have all required properties, the command will not be executed.

      By default, this returns an empty list. Subclasses that require specific properties should override this method.

      Returns:
      A list of all required properties.

    • getRetrieverResult

      public @Nullable Structure getRetrieverResult()
      The result of the structureRetriever.

      This will not be available until after executeCommand(PermissionsStatus) has started, but before performAction(Structure) is called.

      Even after the result has been set, it may still be null in case no doors were found.
